project_type: Next.js 14 + TypeScript frontend using App Router, part of ExamGuard exam management system
build_system: Next.js with npm scripts, uses Tailwind CSS for styling
test_framework: No test framework configured - tests should be added via Jest/React Testing Library
test_command: npm run lint && npm run type-check
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation, npm run lint for code style, manually test error boundaries by triggering errors in development mode
snapshot_or_generated_files: Next.js generates .next/ build directory, not checked in
environment_constraints: Uses React 18, Next.js 14 App Router, requires browser localStorage for auth tokens
contribution_requirements: Follow existing TypeScript patterns, use Tailwind classes, maintain accessibility standards, integrate with existing toast notification system
key_patterns: Components in src/components/ with ui/ subdirectory for reusable UI, hooks in src/hooks/, contexts in src/contexts/, API client in src/lib/api.ts with axios interceptors, uses Zod for validation
directory_structure: src/app/ for Next.js App Router pages, src/components/ for React components (ui/ for reusable), src/lib/ for utilities, src/contexts/ for React contexts, src/hooks/ for custom hooks
